event.quote: On November 22, 2026, the Board of Directors of NVIDIA Corporation reinstated Jen-Hsun Huang as NVIDIA's President, Chief Executive Officer and member of the Board of Directors, effective immediately.

watch.note: Headlines report that Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO in late November, and Trump says Huang is happy to return as CEO.

digest.summary: US stocks found footing on November 27 after a bruising month, with the dollar on track for a third monthly gain and oil set to snap a three-week losing streak on supply fears. Headlines say Trump was briefly 'concerned' by Wednesday's market before stocks recovered. Renewed tech optimism lifted pre-bell futures after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, though headlines also note lingering worries about AI-trade volatility and regulatory probes. The S&P 500 is reported here as 8.0% below its one-year high, and consumer staples (XLP) have led the S&P 500 by about 13.5 points.
digest.fed_note: Fed headlines are routine (discount rate minutes, FOMC minutes from October 27-28, and regulatory notices) and do not clearly signal the direction of policy.
digest.sector_note: The headlines do not explain why consumer staples are leading; they only note consumers hunting for value amid inflation, with retailers expecting robust holiday spending.
digest.huang_note: Headlines report that Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO in late November, and Trump says Huang is happy to return as CEO.
